
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zjdxr-up/p/19316219" title="发布于 2025-12-06 17:08">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Spring boot 中 CommandLineRunner 在服务启动完成后自定义执行</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>转载请注明出处：</p>
<p>　　以下是 Spring boot中 CommandLineRunner 的定义：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">package</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> org.springframework.boot;

@FunctionalInterface
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CommandLineRunner {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> run(String... args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　CommandLineRunner 是 Spring Boot 提供的一个重要接口，用于在应用程序启动完成后执行特定逻辑。　</p>
<p>关键特性：</p>
<ul>
<li>@FunctionalInterface：标记为函数式接口，支持 Lambda 表达式</li>
<li>run(String... args)：核心方法，在Spring Boot应用启动完成后执行</li>
<li>args参数：接收命令行参数</li>
<li>throws Exception：允许抛出异常</li>
</ul>
<p>使用场景</p>
<ul>
<li>应用启动后初始化数据</li>
<li>执行一次性任务</li>
<li>启动后台服务</li>
<li>验证配置信息</li>
</ul>
<h2>1. 基础实现方式</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@Component
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> StartupRunner <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CommandLineRunner {
    
    @Override
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> run(String... args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception {
        System.out.println(</span>"Application started with command-line arguments: " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Arrays.toString(args));
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理命令行参数</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = 0; i &lt; args.length; ++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i) {
            System.out.println(</span>"arg[" + i + "]: " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> args[i]);
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h2>2. 多个CommandLineRunner执行顺序</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@Component
@Order(</span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> FirstRunner <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CommandLineRunner {
    @Override
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> run(String... args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception {
        System.out.println(</span>"First runner executed"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}

@Component
@Order(</span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> SecondRunner <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CommandLineRunner {
    @Override
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> run(String... args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception {
        System.out.println(</span>"Second runner executed"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h2>3.执行时机</h2>
<p>CommandLineRunner 的 run() 方法在以下阶段执行：</p>
<ul>
<li>Spring Boot应用完全启动</li>
<li>SpringApplication.run() 方法完成</li>
<li>Web服务器已启动并监听端口（如果是Web应用）</li>
<li>所有 @PostConstruct 方法执行完毕</li>
<li>在 ApplicationReadyEvent 发布之前</li>
</ul>
<h2>&nbsp;</h2>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
